newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bonds close sharply up on U.S. CPI data.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bonds close sharply up on U.S. CPI data.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Dutch bonds rise sharply in afternoon trading after release of lower than expected U.S. August CPI data lifts U.S. treasuries and, with them, European bonds. Dutch market still suffers from lack of end-investor interest. Trading largely professional. Curve steepens.
* July 6.25 1998s +0.13 to 104.59/67, for a bid yield of 3.60 pct, seven basis points lower than at Thursday's close
* Jan 2006s +0.72 to 99.46/54, for a bid yield of 6.07 pct (-11bp), bp under the bund
* Jan 2023s +1.30 to 108.74/94, yielding 6.78 pct (-10bp) on the bid
